cells.quote: Compared with controls, the intervention improved the HEI-2015 “Total Vegetables” component (+4% vs. −2%; p = 0.003) and modestly increased the percentage of energy from protein (+0.4% vs. −0.3%; p = 0.021).
cells.note: The supplied study text does not include the TX Sprouts results sentence; this quote is copied from the wiki entry.
